proposed.explanation: Your friend's statement is incorrect. Telecom Egypt reported a net profit for 2025 of 22578063000 EGP, not 225.9 billion EGP. The 225.9 billion figure actually represents total assets of 225882527000 EGP as of 31/12/2025. Net profit more than doubled from 10111328000 EGP in 2024 to 22578063000 EGP in 2025, rather than increasing ten-fold. Operating revenues also grew significantly from 81677812000 EGP in 2024 to 106672946000 EGP in 2025, while basic and diluted earnings per share rose from 4.79 EGP per share in 2024 to 11.93 EGP per share in 2025. Putting all 50,000.00 EGP of cash into ETEL would create extreme portfolio concentration risk in a single stock, which is inadvisable for a retirement goal. Purchasing 175 shares at 141.95 EGP per share costs 24841.25 EGP, which allows you to build on strong financial performance over a 5-year horizon while preserving over half your cash reserves.
